# 0xRay

> 0xRay is a three-subsystem autonomous engine. The suit is the wear.

**4.1** — a suit that survives the context window. Inference remembers. External Governance judges. The Autonomous Engine runs the work. The host you already run wears it: Grok, OpenCode, Hermes, OpenClaw, or Cursor. When the window closes, the next session wakes with the job, the page, and the laws.

Install:

```
npm install 0xray
npx 0xray wear
```

## Docs

- [Introduction](https://docs.0xray.dev/docs/introduction): what the suit is
- [Getting started](https://docs.0xray.dev/docs/guides/getting-started): wear, four chat bridges + Cursor hooks, seven MCP
- [Integrations](https://docs.0xray.dev/docs/guides/integrations): Grok, OpenCode, Hermes, OpenClaw
- [Grok floor](https://docs.0xray.dev/docs/architecture/GROK_GUIDE): Read the station card; do not thicken the exo
- [Consumer migration](https://docs.0xray.dev/docs/guides/consumer-migration): upgrade from 3.x
- [Vision](https://docs.0xray.dev/docs/architecture/v4-vision): exo, not toolset
